1.description: Vendela is a stable 2-krona that is well suited for sailing training, teamwork and exercises close to shore.

2.description: Piff is a small optimist dinghy that is perfect for younger scouts learning the basics of sailing.

3.description: Puff is used for beginner sailing and helps scouts practice steering, balance and safety on the water.

4.description: Goofy is used for dinghy sailing and is a good boat for scouts who want to develop their sense of sail, wind and balance.

5.description: Our companion boat is a Big-Buster specially converted for scouting activities. The boat is well suited for transport and surveillance.

6.description: Nocke is an easy-to-sail training boat that works well for both beginners and scouts with a little more experience.

7.description: Lumbago is a larger sailboat that is suitable for longer sailing trips, navigation training and activities with several scouts on board.

8.description: Cephalea is a safe and compact sailboat that is well suited for touring, exercises and scout activities on Lake Mälaren.
